qualityIssues: The HTML lang attribute is incorrectly set to 'al' instead of 'sq'.
Inconsistent grammatical agreement (e.g., 'Sektori programe' instead of 'Sektori i programeve', 'forcojnë' instead of 'forcojmë').
Awkward phrasing and calques from English/Macedonian (e.g., 'I mbrojtur brenda raportimi', 'Një klik për të gjitha shërbimet').
Missing definite articles or incorrect use of prepositions (e.g., 'Regjistra inspektime licenca lista çmime', 'te produktet bazë').
Incorrect noun-adjective agreement (e.g., 'punë legale dhe të mbrojtur sezonale' instead of 'punë sezonale legale dhe e mbrojtur').
Incorrect use of definite articles with proper nouns (e.g., 'Kryqi i Kuq Të Republikës' instead of 'i Republikës', 'Qeveria të Republikës' instead of 'e Republikës').
Some UI elements are left in English (e.g., 'Menu toggler AL Toggle search', 'Expand button', 'Open Link Here', 'Accessibility button').
technicalTermIssues: Use of 'risqet' instead of the more standard 'rreziqet'.
Grammatical errors in technical lists (e.g., 'Regjistra inspektime licenca lista çmime').
evaluation.summary: The Albanian version of the website contains a substantial amount of content, but its linguistic quality is inconsistent, showing numerous grammatical errors, awkward phrasing, and calques. The HTML lang attribute is incorrectly set to 'al' instead of 'sq', and while Albanian characters are present, the overall fluency is compromised. These issues detract from the professionalism and accessibility expected of a government website.
recommendations: Correct the HTML lang attribute from 'al' to 'sq' for proper language identification and accessibility.
Conduct a thorough linguistic review by a native Albanian speaker to correct grammatical errors, improve phrasing, and ensure natural flow.
Standardize the translation of technical and legal terms, ensuring consistency and adherence to standard literary Albanian.
Review and rephrase UI elements that are currently in English (e.g., 'Open Link Here', 'Expand button') to Albanian.
Pay close attention to noun-adjective agreement, definite article usage, and prepositional phrases throughout the site.
